The journal can be switched off, and the server's accounts and settings can now be backed up.

### 🌟 Highlights
- **Turn the journal off.** If you never keep a journal, *Settings → Journal → Use the journal* hides it: it leaves the sidebar, the reminder stops, and its entries leave search and the slash menu. A link to a journal day opens a quiet "The journal is off" page with a button to turn it back on. It is a setting for your own account. Nothing is deleted or moved, trashed days are kept, and turning it on again brings everything back as it was. Your journal export still works while it is off. [Turning the journal off](https://papyra.app/docs/journal)
- **Instance backup.** Administrators can back up the server itself: accounts, passkeys, authenticators, sharing, API keys, webhooks, comments and the email and SSO settings, as one encrypted file. A fresh install can restore it from the setup screen. It holds no notes; those stay in your folder. [Instance backup](https://papyra.app/docs/backups)

### 🐛 Fixes
- Downloading a single note now includes its attachments.

### 🔒 Security
- Cleared the dependency audit findings, including a critical one in `shell-quote`.

**Upgrade:** `docker compose pull && docker compose up -d` · **Full changelog:** [v1.1.1...v1.2.0](https://github.com/lyfie-org/papyra/compare/v1.1.1...v1.2.0)
